newsitem.title: INDIA: India to require 8.4 mln T/yr edible oil by 2000.
newsitem.headline: India to require 8.4 mln T/yr edible oil by 2000.

text.p: India will need 8.4 million tonnes a year of edible oil for internal consumption by the turn of the century, compared to a projected domestic output of 7.52 million, a government official said on Thursday.

"As per the latest estimates, the total requirement of edible oils in the country by the year 2000 is estimated at 8.4 million tonnes," Food and Civil Supplies minister Devendra Prasad Yadav told parliament.
Yadav said targeted production of oilseeds by the turn of the century was 26 million tonnes.
He said the government was taking steps to increase production by expanding the area under oilseed cultivation through sequential cropping and inter-cropping.
